minutes.headline: Select Board heard a 372,000 sq ft warehouse proposal and ratified two DPW hires; no budget action
minutes.summary: The board heard a preliminary presentation on a large warehouse at 475 Leominster-Shirley Road, with discussion of the turn lane, traffic safety and truck wear on roads. It ratified two DPW appointments, got DPW and town manager updates, and approved prior minutes and an RFP for 30 School Street. Parcel 7 sale was held to next week.

what_happened.line: The Select Board heard a preliminary presentation on a large warehouse at 475 Leominster-Shirley Road; no vote was taken and it goes next to planning board site plan review.
The board and the DPW director discussed who bears long-term road wear from truck traffic, and said Chapter 90 and pavement management funds were insufficient.
The board voted, with none opposed, to ratify the appointments of a temporary recreation director and a facilities custodian.
The sale of Parcel 7 at 671 West Street was held to next week while the town manager asks the open space committee to comment.
The board voted, with none opposed, to recommend sending out the revised RFP for landscape architectural services at 30 School Street.

why_it_matters: A warehouse of this size would change the commercial tax base and put heavy truck traffic on town roads, and the road repair funds the board named as insufficient are what would pay for the wear.
Parcel 7 is town-owned land, and the board is waiting on the open space committee before deciding whether to advertise it for sale.
watch_next: Select Board meeting on Sept 21, when Parcel 7 returns to the agenda.
Planning board hearings on the warehouse site plan, which the town manager is to ask the planning board to keep the Select Board informed of.
